description: Open each model in the interactive session, run steps and C# code, export, save as requested, and close. In-place saves and code need a confirm_token from the preview response. dry_run forces code.transaction="auto" and reports the override in warnings. A long action can return status=running and jobId when the wait budget expires; it may already have changed the model, and revit_jobs returns its result. Resubmitting repeats the action.
name: revit_process_models
title: Process Many Models

description: Edit an open family in place, or named project families (exact names or ["*"]), one load cycle each. A dry run rolls back all changes. A long action can return status=running and jobId when the wait budget expires; it may already have changed the model, and revit_jobs returns its result. Resubmitting repeats the action.

document.description: Title or file name substring of the target open document; needed when several are open.

name: revit_edit_families
title: Edit Families

description:
Set a view's lighting: shadows, sun position, ground plane, background and lighting scheme.

        View-specific sun and shadow settings; a view that shares them passes the change on.
        Sun angles come as a pair, and gradient colors need the gradient background.
        dry_run returns the same verification block without changing the model.
name: revit_set_view_lighting
title: Set View Lighting

description:
Create a level at an elevation, optionally with its floor plan.

        A level whose name already exists is refused. dry_run returns the same verification block
        without changing the model.
name: revit_create_level
title: Create Level

description:
Create a floor from a closed boundary on a level.

        `points_mm` is the polygon, three vertices or more, each [x, y] in millimetres; consecutive
        duplicates are refused. dry_run returns the same verification block without changing the model.
name: revit_create_floor
title: Create Floor

description:
Set the creation and demolition phase of elements.

        An empty string clears a phase and null leaves it alone; at least one must be given.
        dry_run returns the same verification block without changing the model.
name: revit_set_phase
title: Set Phase

description:
Merge one phase into another and delete the emptied phase.

        Reports how many elements moved each way and how many references remain to the source.
        dry_run returns the same verification block without changing the model.
name: revit_merge_phases
title: Merge Phases

description:
Give elements new element IDs by copying each one over its original.

        The API cannot assign an element ID, so every element is copied, checked and then replaces
        its original. Elements that cannot be replaced are refused by name, and a real run is
        refused when any element in the selection is. dry_run returns the same block without keeping
        the changes.
name: revit_reset_element_ids
title: Reset Element Ids

description:
Rebuild the model into a new document so every element gets a new element ID.

        `destination_path` is the new model, with {n} replaced by the copy number when `copies`
        exceeds one. Reports the old to new pairing, the per-file results and the category counts.
        dry_run reports the plan without writing files.
name: revit_rebuild_model_ids
title: Rebuild Model Ids

description:
Write the element identifier register of the drawn components to a workbook, read-only.

        `fields` picks the columns and `path` names the file, which must not already exist; without
        one the workbook goes to Documents/RevitModelMcp/Exports with a timestamp. Non-component
        categories are reported under skippedCategories and the list is capped at 50,000 rows.
        The workbook is written on the Revit workstation; nothing is downloaded.
name: revit_export_element_ids
title: Export Element Ids

description: Start a persistent, read-only run over local, UNC or RSN models. open_timeout_minutes is the per-model open deadline (default 30, 45 when upgrading in memory).
name: revit_batch_start
title: Start batch collection

description: Read durable run and model status after the initiating client exits.
name: revit_batch_status
title: Batch collection status

description: Persist cancellation and prevent unstarted models from running.
name: revit_batch_cancel
title: Cancel batch collection

description: Download completed snapshots to new local files without overwriting.
name: revit_batch_fetch
title: Fetch batch snapshots

description: Build a local Excel report from snapshots without contacting Revit.

findings.description: Optional findings with model, severity, rule, element_ids (or elementIds), and recommendation.

output_path.description: New .xlsx file path, resolved on the machine running this server; existing files are never replaced.

previous_dir.description: Optional directory of earlier snapshots matched by model title for the Changes sheet.

snapshots_dir.description: Directory of schema-version-1 JSON snapshots on the MCP client machine.

name: revit_build_report
title: Build Snapshot Report

description: Write a new local .xlsx issue register with element snapshots and review documents. Takes 1 to 60 issues; captures at most 25 snapshots (by severity) within a 210-second budget, and failed snapshots become cell notes. Snapshots need local or SSH transport. Existing output files are refused. A non-empty skipped list means the result is incomplete; skippedCount counts all skipped entries.

document.description: Title or file name substring of the target document; needed when several Revit instances run.

output_path.description: New .xlsx issue register path, resolved on the machine running this server; existing files are refused.

pixel_size.description: PNG size in pixels along the fitted dimension, 32 to 4000 (default 1600); Revit rejects smaller images.

process_id.description: Revit process ID; takes precedence over document.

name: revit_issue_register
title: Issue Register
